document_title: The load went to the wind. An AI data center plan beside Briscoe Wind

slides.headline: The load went to the wind
slides.dek: Soluna announced on October 21st a deal with Applied Digital to form a company for a 50 MW AI data center beside the Briscoe Wind Farm near Silverton. Closing depends in part on a tax abatement in Briscoe County. Drawn to illustrate.

slides.headline: 397 acres near Silverton
slides.dek: Soluna bought the land in August for Dorothy 3, its planned AI campus. The square is 397 acres at the map's own scale. Its place on the map is drawn to illustrate.

slides.headline: Built behind the meter
slides.dek: Soluna describes Project Dorothy as 100 MW built behind the meter at the 150 MW wind farm. In September it said 98 MW was energized. Its chief executive says Soluna was built "to bring load to the generation". One bay stands for 10 MW. Drawn to illustrate.

slides.headline: Directly across from the land
slides.dek: Soluna says the wind farm's substation sits directly across from the land it bought. It says that positions Dorothy 3 for behind the meter access to generation it owns outright. The substation, road and pasture are drawn to illustrate.

slides.headline: The plan is twice the wind
slides.dek: Soluna describes Dorothy 3 as up to 300 MW and the wind farm beside it as 150 MW. Each section stands for 10 MW, a drawing unit. Drawn to illustrate.

slides.headline: Two feeds for Phase 1
slides.dek: Phase 1 of Dorothy 3 is the 50 MW in the deal. Soluna expects it to draw power from both Briscoe Wind and the grid, subject to definitive documentation. One stake stands for 10 MW, a drawing unit. Drawn to illustrate.

slides.headline: Room for more data halls
slides.dek: The 397 acres exceed the 300 acres Soluna first identified for the campus. It says the extra 97 acres leave room to add data halls if more generation or storage becomes available. Squares are drawn to area, not the parcel's shape.

slides.headline: A letter of intent, not a lease
slides.dek: After closing Soluna expects Applied to hold 51% and itself 49%. ChronoScale is majority owned by Applied. It has signed a non-binding letter of intent to lease. Soluna says a lease may not follow. It expects closing by year end. Drawn to illustrate.

slides.headline: An abatement comes first
slides.dek: Closing depends in part on approval of a tax abatement for the project in Briscoe County. The county posts its tax abatement guidelines beside its Commissioners Court agendas. The courthouse is drawn to illustrate a county seat.
